parts:
If I use googlevis outside of shiny. I can create an html file thus

 G4 <- gvisGeoMap(Andrew, locationvar="LatLong", numvar="Speed_kt",

write(G4$html$chart, file='G4.html')

In the ui.R I can then display this via

 includeHTML("G4.html") in ui.R

However, I want to create on the fly equivalents of G4 in server.R
based on varying data.frames named, theData

output$myMap=reactiveUI(function(){

# calculations to create theData
   theMap  <- gvisGeoMap(theData, ....))

))


with htmlOutput("myMap") in ui.R

What more do I need to do to achieve this?

messages.subject: Re: use of googlevis output in shiny
parts:
I used your maps example and added a js section that loads the Google "geomap" package:
 
ui.R:
require(shiny)

initGeomap <- '
<script type="text/javascript" src="http://www.google.com/jsapi"></script>
<script type="text/javascript">
google.load("visualization", "1", { packages:["geomap"] });
</script>
'

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("shiny with googleVis"),
  sidebarPanel(),
  mainPanel(
    HTML(initGeomap),
    htmlOutput("gvis")
  )
  )
)
 
server.R:
require(shiny)
require(googleVis)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 output$gvis <- reactiveText(function(){

G4 <- gvisGeoMap(Andrew, locationvar="LatLong", numvar="Speed_kt",
      hovervar="Category",
      options=list(height=350, region="US", dataMode="markers")
   )
